authority: astronomical coordinate, unit, frame-transform, and presentation-scale metadata only; no astrological, identity, Vitae, governance, Treasury, or capability authority
purpose: Separate heliocentric physical state, geocentric lived sky perspective, topocentric future observation, and human-friendly zoom scales so Tempus can be scientifically grounded without discarding the Earth-centered experience of the sky.

astronomical_unit.status: IAU 2012 Resolution B2 exact conventional unit of length
astronomical_unit.note: 1 au is a unit, not Earth's instantaneous distance from the Sun.

frame_stack.axes: explicit ecliptic frame; J2000 or of-date must be declared
frame_stack.role: physical solar-system overview and orbit/state-vector view

frame_stack.axes: ecliptic-of-date when used for apparent zodiac/seasonal sky context
frame_stack.role: Earth-centered sky perspective: Sun, Moon, planets, zodiac directions

frame_stack.axes: local horizon plus declared celestial frame
frame_stack.role: future local sky, rise/set, azimuth/elevation, horizon and habitat views

frame_stack.axes: declared IAU body frame of date
frame_stack.role: future Gaia/Luna/Mars surface maps, local installations and planetary ARCnet nodes

geometric_transform_same_axes.sun_geocentric_vector: r_Sun^G = -r_E^H when the heliocentric Sun origin is exactly zero
geometric_transform_same_axes.sun_longitude_relation: for geometric vectors in the same ecliptic frame, lambda_Sun_geo = lambda_Earth_helio + 180 degrees mod 360
geometric_transform_same_axes.important_boundary: Apparent observed coordinates additionally require light-time, aberration and selected frame/precession/nutation treatment; do not substitute the simple translation for a production apparent ephemeris.

perspective_law.geocentric_statement: Earth may be the coordinate origin of the user-facing sky without being claimed as the physical center of the universe.
perspective_law.heliocentric_statement: The solar-system overview may be Sun-centered without implying the Sun is the center of the universe.
perspective_law.candidate_law: A Viewpoint May Be Central to Experience Without Being Central to Cosmology.

planetary_reference_values.source: JPL approximate planetary elements, 1800-2050 fit; semi-major-axis-like fitted parameter a_o in au
planetary_reference_values.warning: Use production ephemerides for current positions. These values are scale/reference values, not fixed orbital radii.

region_reference_values.vertical_extent_example: NASA educational approximation extends roughly 0.5 au above/below ecliptic; population is not uniform

region_reference_values.shape: theorized distant thick approximately spherical cloud

zoom_scales.purpose: Earth, Luna, near-Earth/cislunar infrastructure and local ARCnet-node view
Mercury through Jupiter neighborhood; main asteroid belt remains legible
major planets, Pluto-range orbit, and main Kuiper-belt context

zoom_scales.render_projection: logarithmic or discontinuous/focus+context compression required for usability
zoom_scales.candidate_formula: u = log(1+r/r0) / log(1+Rmax/r0), with r0 explicitly declared
zoom_scales.warning: screen radius u is presentation only; numeric physical radius r remains authoritative

zoom_scales.purpose: dodecahedral portal UI, zodiac, constellation, star and deep-sky direction
zoom_scales.key_rule: Sky direction has no implied radial distance. Stars in one portal may be at radically different distances.

scale_transition_contract.key_distinction: Radial distance zoom and angular sky zoom are different coordinate domains.
scale_transition_contract.planetary_to_sky: A user may zoom from a Sol-centered physical scene into an Earth-centered angular sky scene by changing origin/frame, not by pretending the dodecahedron has an AU radius.
scale_transition_contract.sky_to_planetary: A selected sky direction may be retained as camera bearing when switching back to heliocentric space, but the physical scene must recover real distances.
candidate_laws: Change Frame Before You Change Meaning.
Angular Shell Is Not Radial Shell.
Compressed Distance May Aid Orientation; It May Not Pretend to Be Physical Scale.

time_and_ephemeris_provenance.display_time: UTC/local civil time may be shown to humans
time_and_ephemeris_provenance.dynamical_time: TDB/ephemeris time may be required internally for precise state evaluation

sources.supports: reference-frame definitions, geocentric/bodycentric/barycentric centers, ecliptic frames and ephemeris outputs
approximate planetary orbital elements and fitted a0 values
